name: pmjay_verify_beneficiary
description: Verifies a PM-JAY beneficiary using family ID and returns a session_token for authenticated operations. Must be called before pmjay_get_benefit_balance, pmjay_download_ecard, pmjay_get_claim_history, pmjay_check_claim_status, and pmjay_raise_grievance. Does NOT check eligibility (use pmjay_check_eligibility for that).

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

name: pmjay_check_eligibility
description: Checks whether a person/family is eligible for PM-JAY benefits. Must be called before pmjay_verify_beneficiary if the user is unsure of coverage. Does NOT authenticate or return a session_token.

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

name: pmjay_get_benefit_balance
description: Retrieves the remaining PM-JAY insurance benefit balance for a verified beneficiary. Requires pmjay_verify_beneficiary first. Does NOT provide claim history (use pmjay_get_claim_history for that).

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

session_token.description: Token returned by pmjay_verify_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

name: pmjay_download_ecard
description: Downloads the PM-JAY e-card for a verified beneficiary. Requires pmjay_verify_beneficiary first. Does NOT verify beneficiary identity (use pmjay_verify_beneficiary for that).

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

session_token.description: Token returned by pmjay_verify_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

name: pmjay_search_hospitals
description: Searches for PM-JAY empanelled hospitals by location, speciality, and hospital type. Does NOT confirm whether a hospital is currently active (use pmjay_check_hospital_status for verification).

location.description: City or district to search hospitals.

name: pmjay_check_hospital_status
description: Checks whether a specific hospital is currently empanelled and active under PM-JAY. Should be called before visiting a hospital. Does NOT search hospitals (use pmjay_search_hospitals for discovery).

name: pmjay_get_claim_history
description: Retrieves the full claim history for a verified beneficiary. Requires pmjay_verify_beneficiary first. Does NOT provide real-time status of a single claim (use pmjay_check_claim_status for that).

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

session_token.description: Token returned by pmjay_verify_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

name: pmjay_check_claim_status
description: Checks the current status of a specific PM-JAY claim. Requires pmjay_verify_beneficiary first. Must be called before pmjay_raise_grievance. Does NOT retrieve full history (use pmjay_get_claim_history for that).

session_token.description: Token returned by pmjay_verify_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

name: pmjay_search_health_packages
description: Searches for PM-JAY covered treatment packages by speciality or procedure name. Should be called before pmjay_raise_grievance if a procedure is denied. Does NOT raise complaints (use pmjay_raise_grievance for that).

name: pmjay_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance related to PM-JAY services such as claim rejection or treatment denial. Requires pmjay_verify_beneficiary and pmjay_check_claim_status beforehand. Does NOT track grievance status (use pmjay_track_grievance_status for that).

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).

session_token.description: Token returned by pmjay_verify_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

name: pmjay_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the status of a previously raised PM-JAY grievance. Requires pmjay_verify_beneficiary first. Does NOT raise new grievances (use pmjay_raise_grievance for that).

session_token.description: Token returned by pmjay_verify_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

family_id.description: PM-JAY family ID (12-digit identifier assigned at beneficiary registration).
